steps.en: Run the document server container with a JWT secret
steps.zh: 带 JWT secret 起文档服务器容器

steps.en: Put the open document where your storage serves URLs from
steps.zh: 把待编辑文档放到你的存储可发 URL 的位置

steps.en: Embed the editor placeholder in your page and configure it
steps.zh: 在页面里放编辑器占位符并配置它

steps.en: Streams the Word/Cells/Slides-like editor against your file
steps.zh: 对你的文件流出 Word/Cells/Slides 式编辑器

steps.en: Merges everyone's edits into the document in real time
steps.zh: 把所有人的编辑实时合进同一份文档

steps.en: Sends the saved version back to your endpoint
steps.zh: 把保存后的新版本送回你的端点

value.en: Clicking a file in your product opens a familiar, co-editable .docx/.xlsx/.pptx editor — you own storage and accounts, they ship the whole office suite
value.zh: 在你的产品里点一个文件，就打开可协同的完整 Office 编辑器——存储和账号是你的，套件由他们出货
